parameters.jsCode: const input = $input.first().json; const body = input.body ?? input; const required = ['file_name','storage_path','checksum_sha256']; const missing = required.filter(k => !String(body[k] ?? '').trim()); if (missing.length) throw new Error('Faltan campos obligatorios: ' + missing.join(', ')); const checksum = String(body.checksum_sha256).trim().toLowerCase(); if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(checksum)) throw new Error('checksum_sha256 debe contener 64 caracteres hexadecimales.'); const fileName = String(body.file_name).trim(); if (!/\.(xlsx|xlsm)$/i.test(fileName)) throw new Error('Solo se permiten archivos XLSX o XLSM.'); const storagePath = String(body.storage_path).trim(); if (storagePath.includes('..') || storagePath.startsWith('/')) throw new Error('storage_path inválido.'); return [{ json: { idempotency_key: String(body.idempotency_key || `${checksum}:${storagePath}`), file_name: fileName, storage_path: storagePath, checksum_sha256: checksum, requested_by: body.requested_by || null, metadata: { source: 'molino-control', expected_sheets: ['BASE DE DATOS','LIBRO','GUIAS','CODIGOS'], ...(body.metadata && typeof body.metadata === 'object' ? body.metadata : {}) } } }];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_idempotency_key: $json.idempotency_key, p_file_name: $json.file_name, p_storage_path: $json.storage_path, p_checksum_sha256: $json.checksum_sha256, p_requested_by: $json.requested_by, p_metadata: $json.metadata }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ (() => { const row = Array.isArray($json) ? $json[0] : $json; return { ok: true, job_id: row.id, status: row.status, message: 'Importación recibida para validación' }; })() }}
